_documentation.purpose: Maps MoTeC log channels into the normalized replay CSV columns consumed by the correlation replay workflow.
_documentation.format_note: JSON does not support comments, so documentation lives in this object. The extractor only requires the top-level 'channels' object and ignores this documentation block.

top_level_fields.sample_frequency_hz: Default output resampling frequency in Hz. scripts/extract_motec_lap.py uses this unless --frequency is provided.
top_level_fields.channels: Object keyed by normalized replay CSV output column names. Each value describes how to find, scale, derive, clamp, and default that output signal.

channel_spec_fields.names: Ordered list of possible source channel names or aliases from the MoTeC log. The first matching channel is used.
channel_spec_fields.required: If true, extraction fails when the channel cannot be found or derived. If false, extraction continues and fills the output with 'default'.
channel_spec_fields.default: Value used when an optional channel is missing. null becomes NaN in the output CSV.
channel_spec_fields.source_unit_scale: Map from source unit label to multiplier applied to raw source values. The scaled result should be in the output channel's target unit.
channel_spec_fields.clamp: Two-number [min, max] range applied after scaling, offset, or derivation.
channel_spec_fields.sources: Ordered list of alternative source specifications. Use this when different loggers expose the same output signal with different names, signs, or scales.
channel_spec_fields.label: Human-readable source identifier written to the extraction manifest so matched calibration paths are auditable.
channel_spec_fields.scale: Additional multiplier applied together with source_unit_scale. Useful for steering-ratio calibration or sign inversion.
channel_spec_fields.offset: Optional additive offset applied after scaling. Supported by the extractor even when omitted from this default map.
channel_spec_fields.transform: Optional raw-value transform applied before unit scaling. Supported values are documented in _documentation.transforms.
channel_spec_fields.derive: Fallback derivation rule used when no direct channel source matches.

transforms.uint16_to_int16: Decode a channel that should be signed int16 but was stored/exported as unsigned. Unsigned values are first wrapped into the 0..65535 range, so 65536 becomes 0, then values above 32767 are converted by subtracting 65536 before scaling.
transforms.unsigned_negative_torque: Decode the uint16 signed storage quirk, then express the result as negative torque. This is used for Throttle Regen Negative Torque Command because the logger stores the regen-side magnitude/candidate as an unsigned positive value even though correlation wants regen in signed Nm.

derive_fields.method: Derivation algorithm name. The supported method in this workflow is 'brake_pressure'.
derive_fields.combine: How front and rear brake pressure traces are combined before normalization. Supported values are 'sum', 'front', 'rear', 'mean', 'weighted_mean', and 'max'. The default is 'sum'.
derive_fields.normalization: Pressure-derived brake_ratio is normalized by the peak combined pressure in the imported log/window, so the highest observed combined pressure maps to 1.0.
derive_fields.zero_bar: Optional pressure offset in bar subtracted from both axles before ratio conversion.
derive_fields.front_zero_bar: Optional front-only pressure offset in bar.
derive_fields.rear_zero_bar: Optional rear-only pressure offset in bar.
derive_fields.auto_zero_percentile: Optional percentile of each pressure trace to subtract as a measured zero offset before clipping negative pressure to zero.
derive_fields.front: Source specification for the front brake pressure channel. Its scaled unit should be bar.
derive_fields.rear: Source specification for the rear brake pressure channel. Its scaled unit should be bar.
derive_fields.front_weight: Front weighting used when combine is 'weighted_mean'. Defaults to 0.5.
derive_fields.rear_weight: Rear weighting used when combine is 'weighted_mean'. Defaults to 1.0 - front_weight.

configured_outputs.distance_m: Lap distance in meters. Optional; if missing or all NaN, the extractor integrates speed_mps over time.
configured_outputs.throttle_ratio: Driver throttle command as a 0.0 to 1.0 ratio.
configured_outputs.brake_ratio: Driver brake command as a normalized ratio. Can be read directly or derived from front and rear pressure channels.
configured_outputs.brake_pressure_front_bar: Front brake line pressure in bar, carried through for pressure-based correlation braking.
configured_outputs.brake_pressure_rear_bar: Rear brake line pressure in bar, carried through for pressure-based correlation braking.
configured_outputs.regen_torque_nm: Logged throttle regen negative torque command in signed Nm. The raw channel is decoded from unsigned storage and exported negative by convention; it is a regen candidate/command trace and can be nonzero while throttle is active.
configured_outputs.motor_torque_command_nm: Logged BAMOCAR calculated torque command in signed Nm. The raw channel is decoded from unsigned int16 storage so negative commanded torque appears below zero.
configured_outputs.motor_rpm: Logged BAMOCAR motor speed in rpm, used to limit direct calculated-command replay against measured pack power without feeding back simulated speed error.
configured_outputs.pack_voltage_v: Logged tractive battery pack voltage in volts, used to sanity-limit direct calculated-command replay against measured DC pack power.
configured_outputs.pack_current_a: Logged tractive battery pack current in amps. Positive current is treated as pack discharge/motoring power and negative current as charging/regen power.
configured_outputs.steer_rad: Road-wheel steering angle in radians. Use source-specific scale for steering sensor ratio and sign conventions.
configured_outputs.speed_mps: Vehicle speed in meters per second.
configured_outputs.yaw_rad: Vehicle yaw or heading angle in radians.
configured_outputs.yaw_rate_radps: Yaw rate in radians per second.
configured_outputs.x_m: Optional local X position in meters.
configured_outputs.y_m: Optional local Y position in meters.
configured_outputs.gps_course_rad: GPS true course or heading in radians.
configured_outputs.front_lat_accel_g: Front lateral acceleration sensor in g.
configured_outputs.rear_lat_accel_g: Rear lateral acceleration sensor in g.
configured_outputs.lat_accel_g: Legacy lateral acceleration in g, usually the front or CG lateral sensor.
configured_outputs.front_long_accel_g: Front longitudinal acceleration sensor in g.
configured_outputs.rear_long_accel_g: Rear longitudinal acceleration sensor in g.
configured_outputs.long_accel_g: Legacy longitudinal acceleration in g, usually the front or CG longitudinal sensor.
